Exploring schools with high SAT excellence rates and their FRPM eligibility:

QUERY: SELECT cds, sname, NumGE1500, NumTstTakr, CAST(NumGE1500 AS FLOAT) / NumTstTakr as excellence_rate FROM satscores WHERE NumTstTakr > 0 ORDER BY excellence_rate DESC LIMIT 10

QUERY: SELECT CDSCode, `School Name`, `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`, `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)`, CAST(`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` AS FLOAT) / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` as free_rate_5_17 FROM frpm WHERE `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 0 LIMIT 10

QUERY: SELECT s.cds, s.sname, CAST(s.NumGE1500 AS FLOAT) / s.NumTstTakr as excellence_rate, CAST(f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` AS FLOAT) / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` as free_rate FROM satscores s JOIN frpm f ON s.cds = f.CDSCode WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 0 AND f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 0 AND CAST(s.NumGE1500 AS FLOAT) / s.NumTstTakr > 0.3 ORDER BY free_rate DESC LIMIT 5
